7	# PRD — groomr
8	
9	## Vision
10	
11	groomr lets every independent dog groomer take bookings online without phone tag. Pet owners book from their phone, and groomers stop spending their day on the phone.
12	
13	## Problem statement
14	
15	Independent groomers lose hours a week to phone booking, and no-shows cost them about a fifth of their slots. Both figures are the product owner's own account of the problem, not a measured study.
16	
17	## Target users & personas
18	
19	- **Groomer** — runs a small salon. Wants fewer phone calls and fewer empty slots; is frustrated by hours lost to phone booking and by customers who do not turn up.
20	- **Pet owner** — books from a phone. Wants to book a groomer's slot without calling and waiting for a reply.
21	
22	## Goals & success metrics
23	
24	| Goal | Metric |
25	|---|---|
26	| G1 Independent groomers take bookings online | 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31 |
27	| G2 Reduce no-shows | A no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30 |
28	
29	## Features (prioritized)
30	
31	### Must have
32	
33	- [Online booking](features/online-booking/prd.md) — pet owners book a groomer's slot online (supports G1)
34	- [SMS reminders](features/sms-reminders/prd.md) — an SMS reminder the day before the appointment (supports G2)
35	
36	### Should have
37	
38	None.
39	
40	### Could have
41	
42	None.
43	
44	### Won't have
45	
46	- A marketplace ranking groomers — not built; no feature PRD.
47	
48	## Non-functional requirements
49	
50	- The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
51	- The service has 99.5% availability, measured monthly.
52	
53	## Constraints & assumptions
54	
55	- EU customers only.
56	- Data stays in the EU.
57	
58	## Out of scope
59	
60	- Native mobile apps.
61	- Payments.
62	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
63

2	status: "proposed"

5	---
6	
7	# Online booking
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Online booking lets a pet owner book a groomer's slot from their phone, without calling and waiting for a reply. For the groomer it replaces phone booking, which today costs hours a week. It is the first feature built and the one that lets independent groomers take bookings online.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G1** — Independent groomers take bookings online. Every booking made through this feature counts toward the metric of 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — A pet owner can open a groomer's booking page in a mobile browser and see that groomer's available slots.
20	- **R2** — A pet owner can book one available slot from the booking page without phoning the salon.
21	- **R3** — Once a slot is booked, it no longer appears as available on the groomer's booking page.
22	- **R4** — A groomer can see the bookings made for their salon.
23	- **R5** — The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
24	- **R6** — The booking page is available 99.5% of each month.
25	- **R7** — Booking data is stored and processed only in the EU, and booking is offered to EU customers only.
26	
27	## Acceptance criteria
28	
29	- Given a salon with open slots, when a pet owner opens its booking page on a phone, then the open slots are listed (R1).
30	- Given an available slot, when a pet owner books it, then the booking is confirmed on the page without any phone call (R2).
31	- Given a slot that has just been booked, when another pet owner opens the booking page, then that slot is not offered (R3).
32	- Given a booking made by a pet owner, when the groomer opens their bookings, then the booking is listed (R4).
33	- Over a measurement window, the booking page loads in under 2 s for 95% of loads (R5).
34	- Over a calendar month, the booking page is available at least 99.5% of the time (R6).
35	- All booking data is held in EU locations, and the service is not offered to customers outside the EU (R7).
36	
37	## Dependencies
38	
39	None.
40	
41	## Rollout
42	
43	Online booking goes first to a beta group of 20 salons.
44	
45	## Out of scope
46	
47	- Payments, including deposits or paying at booking.
48	- Native mobile apps.
49	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
50

2	status: "proposed"
3	version: 1
4	tickets: []

6	
7	# SMS reminders
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Pet owners sometimes do not turn up, and groomers lose about a fifth of their slots to no-shows (the product owner's own account). This feature sends the pet owner an SMS reminder the day before their appointment, so fewer booked slots go unused.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G2** — a no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30. The reminder prompts the pet owner the day before the appointment, which is the lever this feature uses to bring no-shows down from about a fifth of slots.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — For each appointment booked through groomr, the pet owner receives one SMS reminder the day before the appointment.
20	- **R2** — The reminder is sent only for appointments held in groomr's online booking, to the pet owner who made the booking.
21	- **R3** — A salon receives reminders for its appointments only once the feature flag is switched on for that salon; with the flag off, no SMS is sent for that salon.
22	- **R4** — Customer data used to send reminders (including the pet owner's phone number) is handled and stored in the EU only, and reminders are sent to EU customers only.
23	
24	## Acceptance criteria
25	
26	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag on for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then the pet owner receives an SMS reminder (R1, R2).
27	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag off for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then no SMS is sent (R3).
28	- Given the flag is switched on for one salon, when reminders are due, then other salons with the flag off send none (R3).
29	- Given the SMS handling is inspected, when customer data is traced, then it is processed and stored only in the EU (R4).
30	- Once enabled across salons, the no-show rate trends toward the G2 target of below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30 (R1).
31	
32	## Dependencies
33	
34	- online-booking — supplies the appointments to remind about.
35	- An SMS sending arrangement that keeps customer data in the EU (constraint from the hub); the choice is not made here.
36	
37	## Rollout
38	
39	Ships behind a feature flag, switched on salon by salon.
40	
41	## Out of scope
42	
43	- Native mobile apps.
44	- Payments.
45	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
46	- Reminder timing other than the day before, message templates and handling of replies: not specified, so not part of this feature.
47

---
status: "proposed"
version: 1
tickets: []
---

# SMS reminders

## Summary

Pet owners sometimes do not turn up, and groomers lose about a fifth of their slots to no-shows (the product owner's own account). This feature sends the pet owner an SMS reminder the day before their appointment, so fewer booked slots go unused.

## Goals served

- **G2** — a no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30. The reminder prompts the pet owner the day before the appointment, which is the lever this feature uses to bring no-shows down from about a fifth of slots.

## Requirements

- **R1** — For each appointment booked through groomr, the pet owner receives one SMS reminder the day before the appointment.
- **R2** — The reminder is sent only for appointments held in groomr's online booking, to the pet owner who made the booking.
- **R3** — A salon receives reminders for its appointments only once the feature flag is switched on for that salon; with the flag off, no SMS is sent for that salon.
- **R4** — Customer data used to send reminders (including the pet owner's phone number) is handled and stored in the EU only, and reminders are sent to EU customers only.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given an appointment booked online and the flag on for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then the pet owner receives an SMS reminder (R1, R2).
- Given an appointment booked online and the flag off for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then no SMS is sent (R3).
- Given the flag is switched on for one salon, when reminders are due, then other salons with the flag off send none (R3).
- Given the SMS handling is inspected, when customer data is traced, then it is processed and stored only in the EU (R4).

## Dependencies

- online-booking — supplies the appointments to remind about.
- An SMS sending arrangement that keeps customer data in the EU (constraint from the hub); the choice is not made here.

## Rollout

Ships behind a feature flag, switched on salon by salon.

## Out of scope

- Native mobile apps.
- Payments.
- A marketplace ranking groomers.
- Reminder timing other than the day before, message templates and handling of replies: not specified, so not part of this feature.

1	---
2	status: "proposed"
3	version: 1
4	tickets: []
5	---
6	
7	# PRD — groomr
8	
9	## Vision
10	
11	groomr lets every independent dog groomer take bookings online without phone tag. Pet owners book from their phone, and groomers stop spending their day on the phone.
12	
13	## Problem statement
14	
15	Independent groomers lose hours a week to phone booking, and no-shows cost them about a fifth of their slots. Both figures are the product owner's own account of the problem, not a measured study.
16	
17	## Target users & personas
18	
19	- **Groomer** — runs a small salon. Wants fewer phone calls and fewer empty slots; is frustrated by hours lost to phone booking and by customers who do not turn up.
20	- **Pet owner** — books from a phone. Wants to book a groomer's slot without calling and waiting for a reply.
21	
22	## Goals & success metrics
23	
24	| Goal | Metric |
25	|---|---|
26	| G1 Independent groomers take bookings online | 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31 |
27	| G2 Reduce no-shows | A no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30 |
28	
29	## Features (prioritized)
30	
31	### Must have
32	
33	- [Online booking](features/online-booking/prd.md) — pet owners book a groomer's slot online (supports G1)
34	- [SMS reminders](features/sms-reminders/prd.md) — an SMS reminder the day before the appointment (supports G2)
35	
36	### Should have
37	
38	None.
39	
40	### Could have
41	
42	None.
43	
44	### Won't have
45	
46	- A marketplace ranking groomers — not built; no feature PRD.
47	
48	## Non-functional requirements
49	
50	- The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
51	- The service has 99.5% availability, measured monthly.
52	
53	## Constraints & assumptions
54	
55	- EU customers only.
56	- Data stays in the EU.
57	
58	## Out of scope
59	
60	- Native mobile apps.
61	- Payments.
62	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
63

1	---
2	status: "proposed"
3	version: 1
4	tickets: []
5	---
6	
7	# Online booking
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Online booking lets a pet owner book a groomer's slot from their phone, without calling and waiting for a reply. For the groomer it replaces phone booking, which today costs hours a week. It is the first feature built and the one that lets independent groomers take bookings online.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G1** — Independent groomers take bookings online. Every booking made through this feature counts toward the metric of 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — A pet owner can open a groomer's booking page in a mobile browser and see that groomer's available slots.
20	- **R2** — A pet owner can book one available slot from the booking page without phoning the salon.
21	- **R3** — Once a slot is booked, it no longer appears as available on the groomer's booking page.
22	- **R4** — A groomer can see the bookings made for their salon.
23	- **R5** — The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
24	- **R6** — The booking page is available 99.5% of each month.
25	- **R7** — Booking data is stored and processed only in the EU, and booking is offered to EU customers only.
26	
27	## Acceptance criteria
28	
29	- Given a salon with open slots, when a pet owner opens its booking page on a phone, then the open slots are listed (R1).
30	- Given an available slot, when a pet owner books it, then the booking is confirmed on the page without any phone call (R2).
31	- Given a slot that has just been booked, when another pet owner opens the booking page, then that slot is not offered (R3).
32	- Given a booking made by a pet owner, when the groomer opens their bookings, then the booking is listed (R4).
33	- Over a measurement window, the booking page loads in under 2 s for 95% of loads (R5).
34	- Over a calendar month, the booking page is available at least 99.5% of the time (R6).
35	- All booking data is held in EU locations, and the service is not offered to customers outside the EU (R7).
36	
37	## Dependencies
38	
39	None.
40	
41	## Rollout
42	
43	Online booking goes first to a beta group of 20 salons.
44	
45	## Out of scope
46	
47	- Payments, including deposits or paying at booking.
48	- Native mobile apps.
49	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
50

1	---
2	status: "proposed"
3	version: 1
4	tickets: []
5	---
6	
7	# SMS reminders
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Pet owners sometimes do not turn up, and groomers lose about a fifth of their slots to no-shows (the product owner's own account). This feature sends the pet owner an SMS reminder the day before their appointment, so fewer booked slots go unused.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G2** — a no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30. The reminder prompts the pet owner the day before the appointment, which is the lever this feature uses to bring no-shows down from about a fifth of slots.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — For each appointment booked through groomr, the pet owner receives one SMS reminder the day before the appointment.
20	- **R2** — The reminder is sent only for appointments held in groomr's online booking, to the pet owner who made the booking.
21	- **R3** — A salon receives reminders for its appointments only once the feature flag is switched on for that salon; with the flag off, no SMS is sent for that salon.
22	- **R4** — Customer data used to send reminders (including the pet owner's phone number) is handled and stored in the EU only, and reminders are sent to EU customers only.
23	
24	## Acceptance criteria
25	
26	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag on for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then the pet owner receives an SMS reminder (R1, R2).
27	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag off for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then no SMS is sent (R3).
28	- Given the flag is switched on for one salon, when reminders are due, then other salons with the flag off send none (R3).
29	- Given the SMS handling is inspected, when customer data is traced, then it is processed and stored only in the EU (R4).
30	
31	## Dependencies
32	
33	- online-booking — supplies the appointments to remind about.
34	- An SMS sending arrangement that keeps customer data in the EU (constraint from the hub); the choice is not made here.
35	
36	## Rollout
37	
38	Ships behind a feature flag, switched on salon by salon.
39	
40	## Out of scope
41	
42	- Native mobile apps.
43	- Payments.
44	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
45	- Reminder timing other than the day before, message templates and handling of replies: not specified, so not part of this feature.
46

8	
9	## Vision
10	
11	groomr lets every independent dog groomer take bookings online without phone tag. Pet owners book from their phone, and groomers stop spending their day on the phone.
12	
13	## Problem statement
14	
15	Independent groomers lose hours a week to phone booking, and no-shows cost them about a fifth of their slots. Both figures are the product owner's own account of the problem, not a measured study.
16	
17	## Target users & personas
18	
19	- **Groomer** — runs a small salon. Wants fewer phone calls and fewer empty slots; is frustrated by hours lost to phone booking and by customers who do not turn up.
20	- **Pet owner** — books from a phone. Wants to book a groomer's slot without calling and waiting for a reply.
21	
22	## Goals & success metrics
23	
24	| Goal | Metric |
25	|---|---|
26	| G1 Independent groomers take bookings online | 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31 |
27	| G2 Reduce no-shows | A no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30 |
28	
29	## Features (prioritized)
30	
31	### Must have
32	
33	- [Online booking](features/online-booking/prd.md) — pet owners book a groomer's slot online (supports G1)
34	- [SMS reminders](features/sms-reminders/prd.md) — an SMS reminder the day before the appointment (supports G2)
35	
36	### Should have
37	
38	None.
39	
40	### Could have
41	
42	None.
43	
44	### Won't have
45	
46	- A marketplace ranking groomers — not built; no feature PRD.
47	
48	## Non-functional requirements
49	
50	- The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
51	- The service has 99.5% availability, measured monthly.
52	
53	## Constraints & assumptions
54	
55	- EU customers only.
56	- Data stays in the EU.
57

62	- A marketplace ranking groomers.

7	# Online booking
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Online booking lets a pet owner book a groomer's slot from their phone, without calling and waiting for a reply. For the groomer it replaces phone booking, which today costs hours a week. It is the first feature built and the one that lets independent groomers take bookings online.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G1** — Independent groomers take bookings online. Every booking made through this feature counts toward the metric of 500 bookings a week across all salons by 2027-03-31.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — A pet owner can open a groomer's booking page in a mobile browser and see that groomer's available slots.
20	- **R2** — A pet owner can book one available slot from the booking page without phoning the salon.
21	- **R3** — Once a slot is booked, it no longer appears as available on the groomer's booking page.
22	- **R4** — A groomer can see the bookings made for their salon.
23	- **R5** — The booking page loads in under 2 s at p95.
24	- **R6** — The booking page is available 99.5% of each month.
25	- **R7** — Booking data is stored and processed only in the EU, and booking is offered to EU customers only.
26	
27	## Acceptance criteria
28	
29	- Given a salon with open slots, when a pet owner opens its booking page on a phone, then the open slots are listed (R1).
30	- Given an available slot, when a pet owner books it, then the booking is confirmed on the page without any phone call (R2).
31	- Given a slot that has just been booked, when another pet owner opens the booking page, then that slot is not offered (R3).
32	- Given a booking made by a pet owner, when the groomer opens their bookings, then the booking is listed (R4).
33	- Over a measurement window, the booking page loads in under 2 s for 95% of loads (R5).
34	- Over a calendar month, the booking page is available at least 99.5% of the time (R6).
35	- All booking data is held in EU locations, and the service is not offered to customers outside the EU (R7).
36	
37	## Dependencies
38	
39	None.
40	
41	## Rollout
42	
43	Online booking goes first to a beta group of 20 salons.
44	
45	## Out of scope
46	
47	- Payments, including deposits or paying at booking.
48	- Native mobile apps.
49	- A marketplace ranking groomers.

7	# SMS reminders
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	Pet owners sometimes do not turn up, and groomers lose about a fifth of their slots to no-shows (the product owner's own account). This feature sends the pet owner an SMS reminder the day before their appointment, so fewer booked slots go unused.
12	
13	## Goals served
14	
15	- **G2** — a no-show rate below 5% of appointments by 2027-06-30. The reminder prompts the pet owner the day before the appointment, which is the lever this feature uses to bring no-shows down from about a fifth of slots.
16	
17	## Requirements
18	
19	- **R1** — For each appointment booked through groomr, the pet owner receives one SMS reminder the day before the appointment.
20	- **R2** — The reminder is sent only for appointments held in groomr's online booking, to the pet owner who made the booking.
21	- **R3** — A salon receives reminders for its appointments only once the feature flag is switched on for that salon; with the flag off, no SMS is sent for that salon.
22	- **R4** — Customer data used to send reminders (including the pet owner's phone number) is handled and stored in the EU only, and reminders are sent to EU customers only.
23	
24	## Acceptance criteria
25	
26	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag on for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then the pet owner receives an SMS reminder (R1, R2).
27	- Given an appointment booked online and the flag off for its salon, when the day before the appointment arrives, then no SMS is sent (R3).
28	- Given the flag is switched on for one salon, when reminders are due, then other salons with the flag off send none (R3).
29	- Given the SMS handling is inspected, when customer data is traced, then it is processed and stored only in the EU (R4).
30	
31	## Dependencies
32	
33	- online-booking — supplies the appointments to remind about.
34	- An SMS sending arrangement that keeps customer data in the EU (constraint from the hub); the choice is not made here.
35	
36	## Rollout
37	
38	Ships behind a feature flag, switched on salon by salon.
39	
40	## Out of scope
41	
42	- Native mobile apps.
43	- Payments.
44	- A marketplace ranking groomers.
45	- Reminder timing other than the day before, message templates and handling of replies: not specified, so not part of this feature.
